findings.issue: Task 9 / tech-spec referenced the send-assertion harness as an extension of FunnelExecutionEngineIT. The implementation instead added a dedicated FunnelTestRunSendIT (@Tag("slow"), same MockWebServer-singleton + @DynamicPropertySource + engine.sweep() shape). This is a naming/location divergence only — coverage is equal or better (it inspects path /bot<token>/sendMessage, chat_id, and rendered text, not just request count). No coverage gap.
findings.recommendation: No change needed. Optionally note in tech-spec that the send-IT lives in FunnelTestRunSendIT, not FunnelExecutionEngineIT, to keep the doc aligned with reality.

findings.issue: tech-spec Testing Strategy asks for an InOrder(cancelExistingForPair before insertExecution(depth=0)) Mockito assertion. The service tests are full-context IT (not Mockito-spy), so ordering is proven indirectly: the restart test relies on the partial-unique re-enter index — an insert-before-cancel would trip DuplicateKeyException (->500) instead of the observed clean 2xx + previous-row=cancelled + single fresh running row. This is a sound behavioral proxy (and arguably stronger than a spy), but it is not a literal InOrder verify.
findings.recommendation: Accept as-is (Task 2 deviation already documents this and it is allowed by the task). The depth=0 enroll, cancel-before-insert ordering, and restart semantics are all observable from repository state; a Mockito spy would add nothing the state assertions don't already guarantee.
